answer: The lantern receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a nebula seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A pre-written answer bank hence goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 90 aliases trips the duplicate check at the dawn gate. Honest users pay that once, farms 18 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
